## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes (format + lint + build + typecheck + test + SBOM).
- [ ] New behavior is covered by tests (unit, renderer, or e2e smoke as relevant).
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] `docs/STATUS.md` is updated for user-visible changes.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or keys are introduced (directly or in logs).

### Milestone / metadata

For significant commits, add metadata to the commit message (Milestone,
Constraint, Rejected, Confidence, Scope-risk, Not-tested) per
`docs/DECISIONS.md`.
